topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides introductory framing and outlines the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: They detail how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue injury through PAMPs, DAMPs, and various pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Signaling, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Manifestations
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how activated sentinel cells orchestrate the recruitment of circulating leukocytes to inflamed tissues, antigen transport to lymph nodes, and the systemic dangers of excessive inflammatory activation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the active and passive mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue repair, and give rise to chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It delivers the closing remarks and gives a preview of the next lecture topic.
